content.title: Unstable Support | Balance Escalates into a Failed Transfer
content.summary: Let the participant first build up abilities on a fixed route and stable pedals, and then hand her over to a rolling dynamic bearing surface; use multiple cameras to continuously prove balance and displacement, and then make only one transfer attempt away from the bearing surface, and complete the failure proof with clear flying, falling into the water, and personal reactions.

quick_start.input_format: Subject/route/hazardous medium/end point + Stable crossing of baseline + Dynamic bearing surface + Proof of continuous balance + Single transfer failure + Personal reaction
quick_start.recommended_input: The seed beetle first walked steadily across three leaves, then stepped onto the moss drum rolling along the bark track and continued to adjust its balance; it only jumped once, missed the drying plate and fell into the pollen bed, then righted itself and flashed a green light.
required_anchors: Establish one participant, route direction, hazard medium and destination before the hard section.
Show a stable traversal phase before the moving support.
Sustain balance long enough to prove repeated body correction while preserving support and destination in shared geography.
Use one terminal transfer attempt and show miss, impact medium and the participant's reaction without an invented outcome claim.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Let the participant first build up abilities on a fixed route and stable pedals, and then hand her over to a rolling dynamic bearing surface; use multiple cameras to continuously prove balance and displacement, and then make only one transfer attempt away from the bearing surface, and complete the failure proof with clear flying, falling into the water, and personal reactions.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one participant, a visible route and a stable traversal baseline before introducing a support surface that moves beneath the participant. Prove balance through several views that keep body, moving support and fixed landmarks together, then allow exactly one transfer attempt off the support. Close on the visible miss, impact medium and the participant's own reaction without inventing injury, score or victory.

invariants.rule: Establish one participant, route direction, hazard medium and destination before the hard section.
invariants.purpose: Makes success and failure spatially measurable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without route geography, later imbalance has no clear consequence.

invariants.rule: Show a stable traversal phase before the moving support.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting directly on the hard obstacle removes escalation.

invariants.rule: Transfer the participant onto one support whose motion is visible against fixed landmarks.
invariants.purpose: Makes instability physical rather than performative.
invariants.ablation_failure: A stationary prop cannot explain the balance corrections.

invariants.rule: Sustain balance long enough to prove repeated body correction while preserving support and destination in shared geography.
invariants.purpose: Builds credible tension before the exit.
invariants.ablation_failure: Fragmentary close-ups hide whether the participant actually traverses.

invariants.rule: Use one terminal transfer attempt and show miss, impact medium and the participant's reaction without an invented outcome claim.
invariants.purpose: Turns failure into complete evidence rather than humiliation montage.
invariants.ablation_failure: Omitting impact or reaction makes the ending ambiguous.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source live-action young woman and black athletic outfit
the source RoboNeo obstacle-course venue and audience
the source large red rolling cylinder over water
the source missed platform jump and pool reaction staging
